rule: strict equality over the whole final text: every json fence parses to [], or no fences and the entire text is the bare (none) marker
context: every payload is delivered as a SubagentStop under a forked-skill marker sidecar (forkedSkill true, skillName code-review); only the text varies

shapes.headered-json-clean.attest: the two live self-review shapes: header, empty fence, closing sentence
shapes.bare-fence-clean.attest: a fork ending in a fenced empty array with no header
shapes.none-buried-in-prose.silent: the marker inside longer output is not the marker
shapes.none-after-failure-note.silent: an excuse line above the marker
shapes.live-specimen-scope-note.silent: measured live 2026-08: marker, blank line, scope sentence naming the excluded file, em dash byte-exact
shapes.later-fence-carries-findings.silent: the LAST fence is the verdict
shapes.findings-then-exclusion-fence.silent: real findings first, later empty exclusion fence

byte_exactness_note: The payloads are RECORDED data, not authored prose: they reproduce the fork's final text byte for byte, and live-specimen-scope-note.silent deliberately carries a real U+2014 em dash in a tracked file under the recorded-data exemption to the no-em-dash authoring rule. Rewriting it as a hyphen is the exact drift (green on the wrong bytes) this corpus exists to catch.
